c.title: $5,695 / 3br - 1050ft2 - 3 bedroom - heart of Kitsilano, 2 blocks from beach! (Kitsilano on the park)
c.description:
Beautifully furnished self-contained 1050 square foot garden level apartment in the heart of Kitsilano just 2 blocks from the ocean.
This large suite has its own private entrance, yard and outdoor covered patio with garden dining furniture.
The suite faces south and west and is located on West 3rd. Ave. near Macdonald. Easy to get to downtown (8 minutes), airport (20 minutes), UBC (10 minutes). Bus stops at 4th and Macdonald providing for easy transportation anywhere.
There is a brand new high end Fresh Street Market supermarket just steps from the Manor. There are many restaurants in close proximity and lovely walking parks including the beach.
This suite has a beautifully appointed granite kitchen with all appliances, full bathroom and a second two piece ensuite bath. All three bedrooms have a queen size bed with luxurious bedding.
There is a 46 inch flat screen TV, high speed fibre optic WIFI, free parking, telephone and laundry facilities. Private parking is available at extra monthly charge of $150.
The suite has new flooring, leather sofa, work station and electric fireplace.
This is not a high-rise; it is a beautiful Vancouver heritage manor home.
Spectacular restaurants, shops, sports facilities are all a few steps away. No need for a car, as everything is accessible either on foot, bike, bus, shared car ( EVO) or taxi. It is also on a designated bike path.

Ideal for corporate executives, exchange doctors or professors, new arrivals to Vancouver and vacationers requiring comfortable elegant self contained housing while visiting our lovely city.
If you need temporary housing due to renovation or possible insurance claims due to flooding, we provide you a perfect home away from home.

Rental terms on monthly basis, 90 day minimum.
Free street parking as well as private paid parking.
Contact us today.
Enjoy Vancouver at its best with all its beaches, swimming, biking, restaurants, shops - Great location!
